direction: Light, high-key, sophisticated, elegant, minimalist business software

prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create an actual desktop interface mockup for Open Scanline, a local document scanning utility. Landscape 1536x1024. The user's explicit direction is LIGHT, HIGH-KEY, SOPHISTICATED, ELEGANT, MINIMALIST BUSINESS SOFTWARE. This supersedes all earlier dark, instrument, editorial or paper-metaphor directions. Use no reference image. Render a mature, carefully proportioned professional application, exceptionally restrained, calm and functional, NOT a marketing page or concept-art slide.
Visual design: almost white #FAFAF9 app background, pure white control surfaces, dark neutral #25282B text, secondary #697078, very fine #E4E6E7 divider lines, one muted ink-blue #385D7A primary action. Soft but not rounded-toy geometry, 4px corners, absolutely no shadows, gradients, glows, cards, illustrations, page diagrams, oversized file icons, dark sections, colored status backgrounds, all-caps tracked typography, monospaced labels or decorative graphics. Typography: refined neutral sans like Neue Haas Grotesk/Inter. 30px medium page title, 18px body, 14px secondary. Plenty of whitespace but keep field widths appropriate, no full-screen stretched form controls. Precise baseline alignment.
Window has thin light title bar with "Open Scanline" left, unobtrusive native window controls right. Below it a slim utility row "New scan" left, text link "Use an image file" right, separated by a fine rule. Main content is a centered 1220px wide workspace with 72px top margin and 140px side margins. Heading "September invoices" with a tiny pencil edit icon. One short secondary sentence "Create a searchable PDF from 3 double-sided sheets."
Two compact aligned columns beneath title with a generous 88px gutter, NO vertical divider or boxed card backgrounds. Left column heading "Scan settings" 20px medium. Form rows have labels ABOVE controls with normal sentence case. "Scanner" dropdown "Office scanner" and small helper "eSCL · Example device". "Paper source" dropdown "Document feeder". Next row two half-width controls "Sides" dropdown "Both sides" and "Resolution" dropdown "300 dpi". "Page limit" a small numeric stepper "−  6  +" followed by "sides", helper "3 double-sided sheets maximum." Then a thin horizontal divider and a compact disclosure row "Image corrections" with value "None" and chevron.
Right column heading "Output". Field "PDF filename" value "September-invoices.pdf". Field "Page images folder" value "September-invoices-pages", helper "One PNG file per image side." A simple checked checkbox "Make PDF searchable". Under it two compact half-width dropdowns labelled "Engine" value "Tesseract" and "Language" value "English". Small neutral helper "Available in this example". Below fine divider, compact disclosure row "PDF password" with "Off" and chevron.
At bottom of main content, a quiet full-width destination line separated by a single horizontal rule. Left "Save in" label then "Documents / Scans" and small underlined "Choose folder". At right secondary text "Up to 6 sides" next to a refined muted ink-blue button "Start scan" white label, approximately 156x44. Below destination line small unobtrusive note "Page images are saved during scanning. The PDF is created after capture succeeds."
No sidebar, dashboard, wizard, image thumbnails, summaries repeating everything, huge decorative titles, boxed metrics, account/profile, queue, AI badges or cloud. The interaction model is one clear scan job, all needed settings visible. The scanner and tool are fictional illustrative available setup, 300 dpi is a chosen value. All copy precise and readable. Need sophisticated business software, intentionally ordinary controls with exceptional spacing and hierarchy. High key and truly minimalist.

Use case: ui-mockup.
Generate an alternative minimalist LIGHT HIGH-KEY elegant business desktop interface for Open Scanline. Actual app screenshot 1536x1024 landscape, no perspective. Same verified task: three double-sided sheets / six image sides to September-invoices.pdf with Tesseract English searchable text plus individual PNG files. This concept differs through progressive disclosure: a compact centered single-column task sheet guiding an occasional operator through source then output. Do not use two columns like a broad configuration workspace. White #FAFAF9, dark gray type, fine #E4E6E7 rules, muted ink-blue button, refined sans 18px body, 28px title. No shadows, illustrations, page graphics, dashboards, sidebar, rounded cards, gradients, large step circles, serif, dark panels, allcaps, decorative labels or cloud.
Slim titlebar "Open Scanline". Centered content 690px wide, generous blank white margins. At top a small text-only progress trail "Source  /  Output  /  Scan", Output bold, source subtly checked. Heading "Save your scan" 28px and subtitle "Choose the files to create."
First an understated single-line collapsible summary row "Office scanner · Feeder · Both sides · 300 dpi" with text action "Change"; below helper "Up to 6 sides, or 3 double-sided sheets." One thin divider.
Main fields stacked: "PDF filename" "September-invoices.pdf"; "Save in" "Documents / Scans" with "Choose folder". Checked checkbox "Make PDF searchable"; aligned half-width controls "Engine" "Tesseract", "Language" "English"; helper "Available in this example". Then plain permanent output note "PNG page images" with indented path "September-invoices-pages/" and text "One image file per side." A collapsed row "Image corrections and PDF password" and state "None · Off". Small note "Page images save during scanning; the PDF follows successful capture."
At bottom in same narrow column thin rule, "Back" quiet secondary button left and "Start scan" ink-blue button right. This is stage Output; underlying scanner was selected in previous stage, and scanner / OCR are fictional example availability. Do not imply skipping source settings or unsupported capabilities. The concept should feel like a light well-designed native business task sheet, readable understated and precise, with no ornamental elements.

Use case: ui-mockup.
Use the attached newly generated LIGHT Open Scanline preparation mockup as exact reference for typography, high-key palette, centered content width, whitespace, window header and alignment. Generate its SCANNING state, full actual desktop app screenshot 1536x1024. Minimalist elegant business software. White and near white, dark gray sans, fine neutral rules, restrained muted ink-blue. No illustrations, page graphics, cards, dark sections, serif titles, giant numbers, decorative icons, gradients or extra controls.
Keep window header "Open Scanline". Utility row now "Scanning" with no use-image-file action. Same main title "September invoices" at same location. Subtitle "4 of 6 image sides saved."
Two columns same placement as reference. Left heading "Scan progress". A simple thin ink-blue progress bar at two thirds with label "Capture progress" and right "4 / 6". Under bar plain text "Waiting for the next side". Under this a small neutral sentence "Text recognition runs between captured sides." Fine divider, read-only job information in a compact aligned list: "Scanner" "Office scanner"; "Source" "Document feeder"; "Sides" "Both sides"; "Resolution" "300 dpi". Small final line "Limit: 6 sides / 3 double-sided sheets". No time estimate, OCR percentage or overall job percentage.
Right heading "Output". Quiet manifest, no panels: first line "September-invoices.pdf" with small neutral status "Not created yet"; next row "September-invoices-pages/" with "4 PNG files saved". Under folder small four-line list with filenames left and small check plus "Saved" right: page_001.png, page_002.png, page_003.png, page_004.png. Below thin divider note "The PDF is assembled after capture and text recognition." No interactive output edits.
Bottom same destination band separated by thin line: "Save in" then "Documents / Scans"; right modest outlined button "Cancel scan". Footer note "Cancelling keeps completed page images. A final PDF may not be created." No back, New scan, upload, page previews, pause, resume or spinner when exact state is not known. Use no large success graphics or widgets. Cohesive continuation of reference with understated readable 18px text. All job details are fictional.

Use case: ui-mockup.
Generate the final SAVED state of the referenced newly generated LIGHT Open Scanline design. Exact same minimalist high-key business software, centered content, two columns, fine gray lines, restrained muted blue, white background, same window chrome and title positioning, landscape 1536x1024. No new visual language. No huge checkmark, no confetti, no congratulatory copy, no decorative illustrations, no cards, no gradients or shadows.
Header "Open Scanline". Utility row "Saved". Main title "September invoices" at same position as reference, subtitle "6 image sides saved. Your PDF and page images are ready."
Left column heading "Scan complete". Compact aligned summary label/value pairs "Scanner" "Office scanner"; "Source" "Document feeder"; "Sides" "6 sides / 3 double-sided sheets"; "Resolution" "300 dpi"; "Text recognition" "Tesseract · English". Below thin horizontal rule and plain medium text "Stopped at the 6-side limit." Helper "Check the feeder for any remaining sheets." Below a little more space and small secondary note "Recognized text can contain errors." No preview or fabricated OCR result.
Right heading "Saved files". First understated row "September-invoices.pdf" with right status check and "6 pages"; beneath small path "Documents / Scans". Second row "September-invoices-pages/" with "6 PNG files"; compact small six-line list page_001.png, page_002.png, page_003.png, page_004.png, page_005.png, page_006.png, each with small check and word "Saved" right aligned. Plain rows no cards and no big icons.
Bottom destination band same as reference separated by a fine rule. Left "Saved in" then "Documents / Scans". Right modest outlined "New scan" and muted blue primary "Done". Small footer sentence "The PDF and page images are stored on this computer." No open file, share, email, upload, pause, resume, rename, automatically identified invoice data, or other new capabilities. This is a fictional fully successful sample job; all files were published before this state. Ensure exact typography, readable body text and generous light spacing.
